name: Receipts
description: Verify work with visual evidence: `/receipt <goal>` makes the agent capture a screenshot or screen recording of the thing actually working, then an INDEPENDENT verifier agent opens that artifact and judges what it can SEE against the goal. Where `/proof` verifies by re-reading the workspace, this one requires a durable artifact a human can look at afterwards. Resubmitting an old capture does not count. `/receipt clear` stops the loop.
tagline: No claim ships without a screenshot

slash_commands.description: Pursue a goal until the agent captures a screenshot or screen recording of it working AND an independent verifier agent confirms, from the artifact itself, that it shows the goal done. Use '/receipt clear' to stop.

fields.label: Required evidence
fields.description: What the agent must capture. Also narrows which file types are accepted as evidence.

fields.label: Maximum verification rounds
fields.description: How many times a verifier agent may reject the evidence before the loop gives up.
